files.description: Daily OHLCV bars. One row per symbol and trading date.
Static symbol metadata used for universe filtering and audit context.
Point-in-time factor inputs for value, quality, size, and liquidity features.
Trading calendar. Closed days should use is_open=0 or be omitted.
Suspension flags used by paper execution and manual-readiness gates.
Point-in-time index or research-universe membership snapshots.

acceptance_criteria: bars.csv must cover the requested date range through the latest completed trading day.
bars.csv must contain at least 300 distinct A-share symbols.
Price adjustment must be consistent with the configured qfq/hfq/raw setting.
Template sample rows and demo data must be fully replaced before import.
stock_info should include ST and delist fields so investable filters can be audited.
calendar and suspensions should be supplied when available to support execution gates.
index_constituents should be point-in-time when used as the research universe.
data_source_qa_evidence_worksheet.csv should be filled from real export evidence before answers are written.
data_source_qa_answers.json must be filled and pass source QA preflight.
workflow_commands: .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe examples\validate_research_csv.py --bars-csv data_exports\bars.csv --stock-info-csv data_exports\stock_info.csv --fundamentals-csv data_exports\fundamentals.csv --calendar-csv data_exports\calendar.csv --suspensions-csv data_exports\suspensions.csv --index-constituents-csv data_exports\index_constituents.csv --start 2024-06-03 --end 2026-07-14 --min-symbols 300 --encoding auto --output-dir results\import\recent_csv_validation

.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe examples\import_research_csv.py --cache tmp\provider_probe_20260715\akshare_current_300_v2.db --bars-csv data_exports\bars.csv --stock-info-csv data_exports\stock_info.csv --fundamentals-csv data_exports\fundamentals.csv --calendar-csv data_exports\calendar.csv --suspensions-csv data_exports\suspensions.csv --index-constituents-csv data_exports\index_constituents.csv --validate --start 2024-06-03 --end 2026-07-14 --min-symbols 300 --encoding auto --output-dir results\import\recent_csv
safety_boundaries: This request is for research and paper trading only.
Do not connect exported files to a real broker order workflow.
Do not treat data availability as a promise of strategy profitability.
After import, real_data_bootstrap and data_audit must pass before strategy evaluation.
